entities.summary: 1970 Black Power Revolution, a transformative movement in Trinidad and Tobago (1968–1975). Emerged from National Joint Act. Catalyzed Black Power demonstrations and army mutiny — February–April 1970 and State of emergency declared — April 21, 1970.
